name: Rekindle
areaServed: Las Vegas, Nevada in person, and anywhere through the live online option
disclaimer: Rekindle is marriage education and guided skill-building. It is not therapy, counseling, clinical treatment, or diagnosis. Facilitators are marriage educators, not licensed therapists or counselors.

services.name: The Rekindle Six-Week Marriage Enrichment Workshop
services.summary: Six weeks, one evening a week on Wednesday from 7:30 to 9: teaching, group discussion, and interactive activities, with light assignments between Wednesdays. Small group limited to 10 couples. Live and in person in Las Vegas, or live online.
services.enrollment_cadence: Wednesday evenings, 7:30 to 9. The event on the calendar is Date Night, Saturday, October 17, at 6 PM in Las Vegas.
services.attendance: both partners attend together, adults 18 and over
included: The full six-week workshop, every session
Live teaching, group discussion, and interactive activities
Ember, your coach between sessions, with a guided exercise you can do at home
An at-home toolkit and weekly assignments
Small-group setting, capped at ten couples
An invitation to the six-month follow-up program

payment_options.name: Pay in Full
payment_options.summary: Paid once at enrollment. Saves $75 off the $600 fee. Nothing further.

payment_options.name: Rekindle EasyPay Plan
payment_options.summary: $50 at enrollment, then $50 per month for 11 months. Automatic billing ends once the $600 balance is fulfilled.

services.refund_policy: If the couple is unable to attend, the payment is refunded minus a $35 processing fee. Transfers to a later session are available. If Rekindle cancels or reschedules a session, the couple may transfer or receive a full refund.
services.how_to_enroll: On https://rekindlemarriage.com/marriageworkshop/#choose, either book and pay now (pay in full $525, or $50 today then $50 a month, $600 total) or reserve a seat for a call with no card. The call path emails the team. Payment stays on rekindlemarriage.com.
services.after_the_workshop: Stage 2 for couples who want to keep going, and a six-month follow-up.

services.name: Ember, practice coach
services.summary: A practice coach between Wednesday sessions. One short guided exercise a couple can try at home, plus Date Night in Las Vegas: a free evening, and only a limited number of invites. Free to try on the home page, no account needed. Included for workshop couples. Not a person, not a therapist, not a crisis line.

services.name: Rekindle Date Night
services.summary: A complimentary in-person evening for 12 couples in Las Vegas: Saturday, October 17, 2026 at 6:00pm. Light dinner, couples games, prizes, and an introduction to Rekindle. Marriage enrichment, not therapy. Reservations required. Exact location sent to confirmed guests.

services.name: Marriage Health Score
services.summary: A free, private two-minute relationship check-up: ten questions, one score out of 100 across five areas (Connection, Communication, Conflict and Repair, Appreciation, and Partnership), with an optional emailed breakdown. A reflective self check-in, not a clinical or diagnostic assessment.

services.name: The Rekindle Journal
services.summary: Research-grounded articles on connection, communication, and intimacy for married couples.

contact.office: 6140 Brent Thurman Way, Suite 100, Las Vegas, NV 89148
